text: Kere ko e makko Alqur'aana jippintee hakkunde amen, o heertora ɗum e hoore amen, menen koohooɓe ɓen? Si ko woni, ɓee sirkooɓe wonii e sikkitagol wayahu mo mi jippini e maaɗa on. Fotde ɓe meeɗaali lepte Allah ɗen, kono hiɓe ɗayintora nennitaneede ɓe. Si ɓe meeɗuno lepte ɗen, ɓe haɓɓitotanooko e yeddugol sirkana Allah, sikkitoo e ko O wahayini kon e maaɗa.
